denied.title: Restricted access
denied.hint: This salon’s public page could not be read with this account.

failure.title: Schedule unavailable
failure.routeMissing: The back-office agenda is not served by the API yet: the grid is displayed, the appointments will follow.

toolbar.timeZone: Times shown in the salon’s time zone ({timeZone})

board.loadingDescription: The appointments for this period are on their way.
board.picked: {client} is picked up: choose a free slot, or press Escape to put it back.

grid.reopened: This slot can be booked again.
grid.freeHint: — book an appointment from this time

start.catalogEmptyDescription: An appointment is booked on a service. Create at least one — duration and price included — before scheduling.
start.periodEmptyDescription: Nothing has been booked here yet. Change the period, or switch to the week view to see further ahead.
start.notInstalledTitle: This salon is not set up yet
start.notInstalledDescription: An appointment is booked on a service, in a practitioner’s agenda. As long as either is missing, this schedule stays empty — tomorrow as much as next week.
start.noStaffDescription: The catalogue is ready, but an appointment needs someone’s agenda. Open a practitioner record: the schedule will give them a column.

move.question: Change practitioner? {client}’s appointment would move from {from} to {to}, on {moment}.
move.conflictBody: This slot is not — or is no longer — bookable: it may have been taken from another workstation, or fall outside the practitioner’s hours. Open the appointment to choose from the slots on offer.
move.goneBody: This appointment no longer exists: it has just been moved or cancelled from another workstation. Reload the schedule.

desk.conflictBody: This slot is not — or is no longer — bookable: it may have been taken from another workstation, fall outside the practitioner’s hours, or no longer be offered for this service. The schedule has been reloaded; pick another time from the list — your other entries are kept.
desk.routeMissing: Front-desk appointment writing is not served by the API yet: the form is complete, saving will follow.
desk.cancelQuestion: Cancel this appointment? The slot goes straight back on sale, and the cancellation cannot be undone.
desk.cancelReasonHint: Optional, and never shown to the client: this is an internal salon note.
desk.cancelConflict: This appointment has just been changed from another workstation: reopen it to see its state before trying again.
desk.serviceHintCancellable: The service of a booked appointment cannot be changed: its price and duration are fixed at booking. To change it, cancel this appointment at the foot of the drawer, then book a new one.
desk.serviceHintSettled: The service of a booked appointment cannot be changed: its price and duration are fixed at booking.
desk.staffHint: With no choice, the server assigns the first one available.
desk.slotsHint: Only the slots the schedule can honour are offered.
desk.slotsEmpty: No slot that day for this service. Change the date, the practitioner, or the service.
desk.slotsUnreadable: The slots offered by the schedule could not be read: type the time by hand, it will be checked when saving.
desk.timeZoneNote: Times entered and shown in the salon’s time zone — {timeZone}. Storage is in UTC.
desk.noteHint: Repeated in the confirmation: the client can see it.
desk.notificationsUnreadable: The message log could not be read.

cancellation.bornOfReportBody: This appointment replaces another one that was moved. The original appointment stayed in the schedule, at its initial time, marked cancelled.
cancellation.reportBody: This slot was freed by a move, not by a cancellation: the client kept her appointment at another time. A move leaves no reason behind.

note.emptyTitle: No note attached to this appointment
note.emptyDescription: Nothing was written at booking. The salon’s internal note lives on the client record.
note.visibility: Visible to the client — this is not the salon’s internal note

client.label: Client
client.searchHint: Search by name, phone or email — {min} characters at least. An unknown client can be created on the spot.
client.noneDescription: Create the record now: the appointment will be booked on it without leaving the schedule.
client.emailHint: The confirmation will go to this address.
client.phoneHint: Optional — for the day-before SMS reminder.

notifications.title: Messages sent
notifications.empty: No message has been sent for this appointment yet.

actions.invalidClient: The client record entered is invalid.
